app.title: NPKStudio
tip.openFolder: Open NPK source folder (a folder of .img files)
empty.dropHint: Drop a .NPK or .IMG here, or press Ctrl+O
canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.desc: Select an IMG to preview its frames here
panel.selectImage: Select an IMG on the left
panel.unsupportedVersion: IMG v{0} cannot be parsed here; it can only be saved as-is
panel.unsupportedOther: This entry is not an IMG (e.g. .ogg); it can only be saved as-is
canvas.pixelAlign.tip: Snap zoom to whole multiples (2×, 3×…) or unit fractions (1/2, 1/3…) and draw the canvas with nearest-neighbour sampling, so pixel edges stay hard
canvas.origin.image.tip: 0,0 = top-left of the current IMG canvas (union bounds of all frames; stays put while switching frames)
canvas.origin.role.tip: 0,0 = character coordinate origin — the same numbers as X/Y in the inspector, for PVF cross-checking
canvas.origin.tip: Ruler origin: {0} — only the numbers change; guides never move
status.guideDragging: Release to place the guide — drag it back to the ruler to delete
status.experimentalSaveCancelled: Save cancelled (the experimental format was not written back)
status.selectFrameFirst: Select a frame on the right first
status.openedFolder: Opened folder {0}, {1} IMG in total (save writes back to the files)
status.openedFolderSkipped: Opened folder {0}, {1} IMG in total ({2} unreadable file(s) skipped)
dialog.open.title: Open package
dialog.openFolder.title: Select NPK source folder
dialog.saveAs.title: Save as NPK
dialog.replace.title: Choose an image to replace with
dialog.exportPng.title: Export current frame
tip.exportNpk: Export as NPK… (in-package paths come from the remembered resource manifest)
tip.manifest: Resource manifest: set or generate a manifest, or export with exact paths
menu.manifest.generate: Generate resource manifest… (from a folder of NPKs)
dialog.manifest.title: Select resource manifest (missing_img_details.txt)
dialog.manifestScan.title: Select a folder containing NPK files (e.g. ImagePacks2)
dialog.manifestSave.title: Save resource manifest
dialog.exportNpk.title: Export as NPK
status.generatingManifest: Scanning NPKs to generate the manifest…
status.manifestGenerated: Generated manifest {1} from {0} NPK file(s) ({2} paths)
status.exportNpkOk: Exported {0} ({1} entries; all paths resolved from the resource manifest)
status.exportNpkOkByName: Exported {0} ({1} entries; {2} of them matched by file name only, not an exact manifest hit)
status.exportNpkOkInferred: Exported {0} ({1} entries; in-package folders sprite/… were inferred from the file name)
status.exportNpkWarn: Exported {0} ({1} entries) — WARNING: {2} path(s) were inferred and may be wrong, so they may not take effect in game. Use "Resource manifest" to specify exact paths
status.manifestSet: Remembered resource manifest {0} ({1} paths); it will be reused for every NPK export
status.manifestMissing: The remembered resource manifest no longer exists: {0}
status.exportNpkNoMatch: No .img of this folder matched the manifest; please pick the right missing_img_details.txt ({0})
effect.tip: Canvas effect (preview only): Original = no processing; Linear dodge = byte-for-byte port of pvfUtility's LinearBrun (ani's LINEARDODGE)
playback.rateTip: Playback rate (base 8 fps): rate × 8 = actual fps. The fps value is shown in brackets so you can compare with ani's [DELAY] in milliseconds
status.lineardodgeTransparent: Under "Linear dodge", {0}% of this frame becomes transparent (solid black is treated as transparent). That is the algorithm's semantics — switch to "Original" to see the raw frame.
inspector.title: Frame inspector
inspector.positionTip: Frame coordinates may be negative (DNF frames often are)
frame.hidden.tip: This frame is hidden: playback skips it, while export / save are unaffected
version.tip.experimental: This version is derived from the legacy implementation and has never been validated against a real sample. Please check the result in game after writing back.
version.tip.passthrough: This version cannot be parsed; it can only be saved as-is.
status.frameLinkNoResize: A LINK frame has no pixels of its own and cannot be resized
status.frameEditUnsupported: v{0} frame tables are passthrough only; insert / delete / move is not supported
status.framesHidden: Hid {0} frame(s) (playback skips them; export / save are unaffected)
status.currentFrameHidden: This frame is hidden: the canvas still shows it, playback skips it
status.playbackAllHidden: All frames are hidden — playback stopped (press H or use "Show all")
status.trimmed: Trimmed {0} frame(s) (transparent border removed, coordinates compensated)
status.trimNoop: Already a tight bounding box — nothing to trim
status.trimFailed: Trim failed: {0} frame(s) could not be decoded
status.pngBatchLinkFrame: Frame {0} is a LINK frame and has no pixels of its own
status.gifNoPixels: No frames to encode (LINK frames have no pixels of their own)
dialog.close.title: Save changes?
dialog.close.message: "{0}" has unsaved changes. Save before closing?
dialog.experimental.title: Confirm experimental write-back
dialog.experimental.message: This IMG is v{0} (experimental). Its write-back is derived from the legacy implementation with no real-sample validation — please check the result in game. Continue?
dialog.experimental.messageV5: This IMG is v5 (experimental). Writing back re-encodes textures as ARGB1555 (no DXT), so the file may get larger and transparent edges harder; it has never been validated against a real sample. Continue?

dialog.exportGif.title: Export GIF
